title: DATEADD moves the first 10 days of a month to the first 10 days of the month before
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 3, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 3, 10 ) )

source.quote: If the <Dates> argument includes the first 15 days in April (15 rows), the result for the previous month includes the first 15 days in March (15 rows).
source.supports: a partial month moves day by day

source.quote: If not all the days of the month are selected, then each day is shifted by the number of intervals specified.
source.supports: a partly selected month moves day by day

derivation: March 1 to 10, 2024 is not a whole month, so each day moves back one month: February 1 to 10, 10 days. Sales on Feb 10: 300.
